data.description: Observability / Security AI Assistant and Agent Builder operations (conversations, tokens, latency, tools) plus Elastic inference usage by feature, model, connector, EIS vs BYO, and estimated cost.
data.title: [Meridian] Elastic AI Assistant & inference usage

panels.title: Elastic AI — Assistant, Agent Builder, and inference

config.content:
## Meridian Dynamics — Elastic AI Assistant & inference usage

Native **Agent Builder** OTel traces (`traces-agent_builder.otel-default`) plus **inference token usage** (`logs-elastic.inference_token_usage-default`) for Observability / Security AI Assistant, Agent Builder copilots, Search Playground, Streams, and EIS endpoints (chat, ELSER, e5, rerank).

Time range: **2026-04-29 – 2026-08-28 (computed at publish)**. EIS = Elastic Inference Service.

[FinOps baseline](#/view/meridian-finops-llm-observability) · [FinOps classic](#/view/meridian-finops-llm-observability-classic).

data_source.query:
FROM traces-agent_builder.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.name LIKE "invoke_agent *" AND attributes.elastic.inference.span.kind == "CHAIN"
| STATS rounds = COUNT(*)

FROM traces-agent_builder.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.name LIKE "chat *"
| STATS requests = COUNT(*)

FROM traces-agent_builder.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.name LIKE "chat *"
| STATS tokens = SUM(TO_LONG(attributes.gen_ai.usage.input_tokens))

FROM traces-agent_builder.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.name LIKE "chat *"
| STATS tokens = SUM(TO_LONG(attributes.gen_ai.usage.output_tokens))

FROM logs-elastic.inference_token_usage-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS cost = SUM(labels.cost_usd)

FROM traces-agent_builder.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.name LIKE "execute_tool *"
| STATS errors = COUNT(*) WHERE status.code == "Error", calls = COUNT(*)
| EVAL error_rate = errors * 1.0 / calls, min = 0, max = 0.12, goal = 0.02

config.title: Daily input vs output tokens (chat spans)

data_source.query:
FROM traces-agent_builder.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.name LIKE "chat *"
| STATS input = SUM(TO_LONG(attributes.gen_ai.usage.input_tokens)), output = SUM(TO_LONG(attributes.gen_ai.usage.output_tokens)) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d)
| SORT day

FROM traces-agent_builder.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.name LIKE "invoke_agent *" AND attributes.elastic.inference.span.kind == "CHAIN"
| STATS rounds = COUNT(*) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d), agent = attributes.gen_ai.agent.name
| SORT day

panels.title: AI Assistant & Agent Builder — agents, models, tools

config.content: Operational view from Agent Builder traces: `chat *` spans carry tokens and model, `invoke_agent *` + `CHAIN`/`AGENT` span kinds are conversation rounds vs executions, `execute_tool *` is tool use (ES|QL, search, mappings, skills).

data_source.query:
FROM traces-agent_builder.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.name LIKE "chat *"
| STATS input = SUM(TO_LONG(attributes.gen_ai.usage.input_tokens)), output = SUM(TO_LONG(attributes.gen_ai.usage.output_tokens)), requests = COUNT(*) BY model = attributes.gen_ai.request.model, provider = attributes.gen_ai.provider.name
| SORT input DESC

FROM traces-agent_builder.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.name LIKE "invoke_agent *" AND attributes.elastic.inference.span.kind == "AGENT"
| STATS runs = COUNT(*), p95_s = PERCENTILE(duration, 95) / 1000000000.0 BY agent = attributes.gen_ai.agent.name
| SORT runs DESC

FROM traces-agent_builder.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.name LIKE "execute_tool *"
| STATS calls = COUNT(*), errors = COUNT(*) WHERE status.code == "Error", avg_ms = AVG(duration) / 1000000.0 BY tool = attributes.gen_ai.tool.name
| EVAL error_rate = errors * 1.0 / calls
| SORT calls DESC

FROM traces-agent_builder.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.name LIKE "invoke_agent *" AND attributes.elastic.inference.span.kind == "CHAIN"
| STATS rounds = COUNT(*) BY user = COALESCE(user.name, user.hash), team = COALESCE(labels.team, "untagged")
| SORT rounds DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM traces-agent_builder.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.name LIKE "invoke_agent *" AND attributes.elastic.inference.span.kind == "CHAIN"
| STATS rounds = COUNT(*) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d), agent = attributes.gen_ai.agent.name
| SORT day

FROM traces-agent_builder.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.name LIKE "chat *"
| STATS requests = COUNT(*) BY model = attributes.gen_ai.request.model
| SORT requests DESC
| LIMIT 12

FROM traces-agent_builder.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.name LIKE "invoke_agent *" AND attributes.elastic.inference.span.kind == "CHAIN"
| STATS p95_s = PERCENTILE(duration, 95) / 1000000000.0
| EVAL min = 0, max = 60, goal = 8

FROM traces-agent_builder.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.name LIKE "chat *"
| STATS requests = COUNT(*) BY provider = attributes.gen_ai.provider.name

FROM traces-agent_builder.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.name LIKE "chat *"
| STATS tokens = SUM(TO_LONG(attributes.gen_ai.usage.input_tokens)) BY model = attributes.gen_ai.request.model
| SORT tokens DESC
| LIMIT 8

panels.title: Inference token usage — features, EIS, connectors

config.content: Kibana inference-plugin shape: `token_usage.*`, `model.*`, `inference.feature_id` / `connector_id`. Features include Observability AI Assistant, Agent Builder, Security AI Assistant, Search Playground, and Streams Significant Events. Chat completions plus ELSER / e5 / rerank task types.

data_source.query:
FROM logs-elastic.inference_token_usage-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| EVAL origin = CASE(inference.service == "elastic", "Elastic Inference Service", "BYO / external")
| STATS tokens = SUM(token_usage.total_tokens), cost = SUM(labels.cost_usd) BY origin
| SORT tokens DESC

config.title: Daily tokens by Kibana AI feature

data_source.query:
FROM logs-elastic.inference_token_usage-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS tokens = SUM(token_usage.total_tokens) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d), feature = inference.feature_name
| SORT day

FROM logs-elastic.inference_token_usage-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS tokens = SUM(token_usage.total_tokens), prompt = SUM(token_usage.prompt_tokens), completion = SUM(token_usage.completion_tokens), requests = COUNT(*), cost = SUM(labels.cost_usd) BY feature = inference.feature_name
| SORT tokens DESC

FROM logs-elastic.inference_token_usage-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS cost = SUM(labels.cost_usd), tokens = SUM(token_usage.total_tokens) BY team = labels.team
| SORT cost DESC

FROM logs-elastic.inference_token_usage-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS tokens = SUM(token_usage.total_tokens), cost = SUM(labels.cost_usd) BY feature = inference.feature_name, connector = inference.connector_id
| SORT tokens DESC
| LIMIT 40

FROM logs-elastic.inference_token_usage-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS requests = COUNT(*) BY task = inference.task_type
| SORT requests DESC

config.title: Model × provider × task — tokens, cost, requests

data_source.query:
FROM logs-elastic.inference_token_usage-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS tokens = SUM(token_usage.total_tokens), cost = SUM(labels.cost_usd), requests = COUNT(*) BY model = model.model_id, provider = model.provider, task = inference.task_type
| SORT cost DESC
| LIMIT 20

config.title: Prompt vs cached vs thinking tokens (daily)

data_source.query:
FROM logs-elastic.inference_token_usage-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS thinking = SUM(token_usage.thinking_tokens), cached = SUM(token_usage.cached_tokens), prompt = SUM(token_usage.prompt_tokens) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d)
| SORT day

config.content:
**Streams**

- `traces-agent_builder.otel-default` — Agent Builder OTel spans
- `logs-elastic.inference_token_usage-default` — feature-attributed tokens

Enable Kibana **GenAI Settings → Token usage tracking** for the managed `[Elastic] Inference Token Usage` dashboard on live traffic.
